What time does it get dark in Seattle? [...] What time does it get dark in Seattle?

Today's sunset in Seattle is at 6:06 PM, with full darkness arriving at 7:49 PM (America/Los\_Angeles). The period between sunset and full darkness is twilight, when the sky gradually transitions from light to dark.

How long does twilight last?

Twilight in Seattle lasts approximately 103 minutes from sunset to full darkness (astronomical dusk). This includes civil twilight, nautical twilight, and astronomical twilight.

What is the latest sunset of the year in Seattle?

The latest sunset in Seattle in 2026 is at 9:11 PM on June 25 (America/Los\_Angeles). This falls shortly after the June solstice, the longest day of the year.
